residency_order: Release removed variants before preparing added variants; real loader and borrow-quiescence correctness are outside this model.
transition_cost: Sum every released variant's eviction cost and every newly resident variant's preparation cost. Reacquisition after eviction pays again.
future_decision_cost: Every active decision after the first, including the decision to stop; stopped delivery has no later controller calls.
fixed_control: Best complete fixed resident subset chosen at the first batch; zero future controller calls, same initial eviction and preparation costs.
same_information: All controls receive every future batch estimate, preparation, eviction, holding, memory, status and future decision cost.
exact_dp_contract: NDU must match all exact DP winning schedules and values. Strict value superiority over the same-information exact optimum is not an attainable objective.
measurement_contract: Native call, graph construction, independent audit, startup, identity checking and shutdown time are observed separately. Declared application nanoseconds are never reported as measured application speedup.
unsupported_enumeration: The original complete-enumeration cap remains 127 paths; no truncated search is accepted as an optimum.
